fields.name: image
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Optional full-bleed texture. The decorative grid renders with or without it.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Background Image Alt
fields.description: Leave empty — the background is decorative and hidden from screen readers.

fields.name: badge
fields.label: Badge
fields.description: Short monospaced eyebrow above the headline, e.g. "Rubrik Agent Cloud".

fields.name: content
fields.label: Headline and Body
fields.description: Format the first line as Heading 1 (aim for 40–60 characters), then add an optional supporting paragraph.

fields.name: media
fields.label: Media
fields.description: Optional wide image shown below the buttons.

fields.name: mediaAlt
fields.label: Media Alt
fields.description: Describe the image. Leave empty only if it is purely decorative.
